feed_title: Corner Dog Bed 97 x 97cm, Orthopaedic Memory Foam with Bolsters, Waterproof Liner, Washable Plush Cover, Non Slip Base | PawLunova Helvellyn
descriptionHtml:
97 × 97cm. Memory foam. Shaped for the corner they already use.

Helvellyn is a corner orthopaedic memory foam dog bed, 97 × 97 × 19cm, triangular, one size. Cushioned bolsters, a waterproof inner liner and a non-slip base.

Think about where the bed is now and where it started. It started next to you. Then it moved, and moved again. Now it lives in the hallway and your dog lies on the kitchen floor, back to the units. What they wanted was never the bed. It was the corner, and the company.

Two straight 97cm sides sit flat against the walls, so nothing juts into the room to be tripped over.

What they get

  • A shape that belongs: The triangle sits flush in a corner or at a sofa end.
  • Profiled memory foam underneath: A shaped memory foam base rather than loose filling.
  • Practical beneath the plush: A removable short-plush cover over a waterproof inner liner.
  • Easy to move, hard to shift: A reinforced handle carries it and silicone dots keep it put.

Best for: Dogs who want a bolstered edge and their back to a wall. Every other bed here solves a dog problem. This one solves a room problem too.

Why it is worth the money

£129 buys floor you were not using, and keeps them beside you rather than in the hall. Under the plush sit memory foam and a waterproof liner. The foam has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and across 1825 nights, the five years it runs, that is about 7p a night.

The money is not at risk either. Return it within 100 nights, we arrange UK mainland collection, and the refund is full.

Now the catch, and it is real. One fixed size, one fixed shape. Each straight side runs 97cm, so a radiator or a pipe takes that space away. A rectangle can be nudged along a wall. A triangle cannot.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)Shape
One size97 × 97 × 19Triangular

Measure the corner before the dog, then measure your dog curled and allow for the bolsters. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Take the plush cover off and wash it to the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

Will it fit my corner?

You need 97cm of clear wall each way.

What about delivery?

Free over £40. The window shows at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Plans appear beside the card options.

Does it have to go in a corner?

No. A sofa end works the same way.

Is it sensible for a dog slowing down?

Profiled memory foam, 19cm, cushioned bolsters. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

The short-plush cover comes off and washes to its label.

What if they will not go near it?

It comes back inside 100 nights. So does your £129.

Measure your corner and give them the 97cm they already chose.

differentiation_note: The only corner bed in the batch: a fixed triangle that solves a room problem as well as a dog one, for households where floor space is the reason the last bed ended up in the hallway. Its per-night figure is corrected from the stale 8p to 7p (£129 ÷ 1825).
